evidence_required: Record installed-target RED, focused GREEN, full regression, and independent read-only code review
failing_acceptance_criteria: A fresh-install fixture from an installed target preserves its own product ADR boundary and ships only platform SADRs
failing_checklist_items: Installed target Shiki tests recursively copy target-owned numeric ADRs as platform templates
minimal_required_changes: Exclude target-owned numeric ADR markdown files from target-install traversal while retaining SADR files, README.md, and template.md
prohibited_changes: Do not change legacy cleanup authorization, product ADR bytes, approval, CCA, MergeGate, locks, runtime, or unrelated template paths
stop_condition: Stop when an installed target can reinstall into a fixture without copying its numeric product ADRs and all SADRs still ship
verification_commands: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_sadr_install_migration.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_install_completeness.py'
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && bash scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh && bash scripts/test_shiki_adversarial_state.sh && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target .
